dashboardCards.name: Revenue Today / Period / Month
dashboardCards.formula: SUM(Orders.TotalAmount - Orders.RefundedAmount) for non-cancelled paid/refunded orders
dashboardCards.sourceColumns: TotalAmount, RefundedAmount, PaymentStatus, OrderStatus, CreatedAt, Currency
dashboardCards.filters: date, currency, country, supplier, product, category, customer, order status

dashboardCards.name: Orders Today / Period / Month
dashboardCards.sourceColumns: Id, CreatedAt, Currency and filter columns
dashboardCards.filters: date, currency, country, supplier, product, category, customer, order status

dashboardCards.name: Paid / Pending / Cancelled Orders
dashboardCards.formula: COUNT filtered by PaymentStatus or OrderStatus

dashboardCards.name: Cash Position
dashboardCards.formula: SUM paid incoming Payments - paid outgoing Payments through period end
dashboardCards.sourceColumns: Direction, Amount, Status, ProcessedAt, CreatedAt, Currency

dashboardCards.name: Product Status / Stock
dashboardCards.formula: COUNT products by Status; COUNT active variants at/below stock threshold

dashboardCards.name: Top Products
dashboardCards.formula: SUM quantity and revenue grouped by product, top five by revenue

dashboardCards.name: Supplier Operations
dashboardCards.formula: COUNT active suppliers, pending/delayed orders, failed syncs and unprofitable cost mappings

dashboardCards.name: Customer Metrics
dashboardCards.formula: COUNT customers and grouped order activity; lifetime value derived from orders

dashboardCards.name: Support Metrics
dashboardCards.formula: COUNT open/urgent/unassigned tickets and AVG resolution duration

dashboardCards.name: Campaign Metrics / ROI
dashboardCards.formula: SUM attributed revenue, COUNT distinct orders, (revenue-budget)/budget

dashboardCards.name: Loyalty Metrics
dashboardCards.formula: COUNT accounts and SUM earn/redeem points grouped by tier
